currentTwLabel: 取得不動產、廠房及設備

note.zh-TW: 故事第 5 筆的設立費在課程政策下放這一列；IFRS 政策下設立費於發生時費用化，付現改列營業活動。
note.en: Under the course policy the start-up costs in step 5 of the story go on this line; under the IFRS policy they are expensed as incurred and the payment is an operating cash flow.

definition.zh-TW:
為了取得機器設備、無形資產等非流動資產而付出的現金，也就是一般說的資本支出。

這是投資活動最主要的流出；課程政策下，支付設立費也歸在這一列。
definition.en:
Cash paid to acquire non-current assets such as machinery and intangible assets, commonly called capital expenditure.

It is the main investing outflow; under the course policy, paying start-up costs is also classified here.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表投資活動區的第一列。故事裡買電腦設備與支付設立費都填在這裡。CE intensity 與現金流量允當比率都拿這一列當資本支出。
example.en: Where it sits: the first line of investing activities in the statement of cash flows. In the story both the computer equipment purchase and the start-up costs go here. CE intensity and the cash flow adequacy ratio both take this line as capital expenditure.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為買設備當期的損益表會出現一筆大費用。買設備不經過損益表，只是現金換成資產；之後每年的折舊才進損益表，所以現金流出與費用認列的時間差很多。
misconception.en: Expecting a large expense on the income statement in the year equipment is bought. The purchase bypasses the income statement, swapping cash for an asset; only the yearly depreciation reaches profit, so the cash outflow and the expense are far apart in time.
